resumes.title: Full-Stack Engineer (strong match)
resumes.text:
SUMMARY
Full-stack engineer with 6 years of experience building web products with React, TypeScript and Node.js.

EXPERIENCE
Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Brightside Retail (2022-2025)
- Built a checkout flow in React and TypeScript that raised conversion by 12%.
- Managed client state with Redux Toolkit across 3 products.
- Designed and shipped 14 REST endpoints in Node.js and Express backed by PostgreSQL.
- Migrated the billing service from a monolith to separate services, reducing
deploy time by 40%.
- Containerised 9 services with Docker and moved them to k8s, cutting infrastructure cost by 25%.
- Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions and added Jest and Playwright tests, lifting coverage from 35% to 80%.

Full-Stack Developer, Paper Boat Studio (2019-2022)
- Developed internal tools in JavaScript and Node.js used by 200 employees.
- Wrote SQL reports in PostgreSQL that replaced 3 weekly manual spreadsheets.
- Deployed applications to AWS (EC2, S3, RDS).

SKILLS
React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, Jest, Playwright

resumes.title: Backend Developer (tricky cases: fluff, negation, paraphrase)
resumes.text:
SUMMARY
Passionate team player with strong communication skills and a clean code mindset.
Dynamic, results-driven professional who thrives in fast-paced environments.

EXPERIENCE
Backend Developer, Lumen Analytics (2021-2025)
- Responsible for team communication and clean code.
- Led a team of 5 engineers and cut release time by 30%, keeping clean code standards.
- Built a machine learning prototype with Python to classify support tickets.
- Deployed Redis-backed services without downtime during a 3-month migration.
- Not only did I ship the service with Terraform, I also wrote the runbooks the on-call team still uses.
- Designed HTTP endpoints for a mobile app, with versioned routes and token authentication.
- Ran services in containers on a cloud VM.

LEARNING
- I have no commercial experience with Kubernetes.
- I am currently learning Docker.

SKILLS
Python, Redis, Terraform, Linux, Git
